We&#x27;ve also rolled out Video 1.5 Fast on <a href="https://grok.com/imagine?referrer=website&amp;campaign=imagine-video-1-5-blog">grok.com/imagine</a> and our <a href="https://apps.apple.com/app/grok-ai-chat-video/id6670324846">iOS</a> and <a href="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ai.x.grok">Android</a> apps. These are our best image-to-video models yet: better motion, better physics, better audio, at the fastest speeds. We’re also adding features to enhance your creative workflow in Grok Imagine.</p>
<p>Compared to the previous model, 1.5 improves across every dimension that matters for real creative work:</p>
<h2 id="audio-and-speech"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#audio-and-speech">Audio and speech</a></h2>
<p>Sound effects, ambience, and dialogue are generated in the same pass and land on the action. Speech is clearer and better synced.</p>

<h2 id="speed"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#speed">Speed</a></h2>
<p>Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Fast almost doubles generation speed: it produces 6-second, 720p videos in about 25 seconds, down from 40+ seconds in our previous model.</p>

<h3 id="multiple-agents"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#multiple-agents">Multiple agents</a></h3>
